// [FILE_START]: BossSkill.cs
// PATH: ./Assets\_Archive_OldAI\BossSystem\BossSkill.cs
// ------------------------------------------

﻿using System.Collections;
using UnityEngine;

// [VI] Lớp abstract: Không thể tạo file trực tiếp từ lớp này, chỉ dùng để kế thừa
// [EN] Abstract class: Cannot create files directly from this, only used for inheritance
public abstract class BossSkill : ScriptableObject
{
    [Header("Skill Identity")]
    public string skillName = "New Skill";
    public string animationTrigger; // [VI] Tên trigger trong Animator / [EN] Trigger name in Animator

    [Header("Engagement Conditions")]
    public float minRange = 0f;     // [VI] Khoảng cách tối thiểu để ra đòn / [EN] Minimum range to cast
    public float maxRange = 20f;    // [VI] Khoảng cách tối đa để ra đòn / [EN] Maximum range to cast
    public float cooldown = 5f;     // [VI] Thời gian hồi chiêu / [EN] Cooldown time

    // [VI] Biến theo dõi thời điểm dùng chiêu lần cuối
    // [EN] Variable tracking the last time the skill was used
    protected float lastCastTime = -999f;

    [Header("Combat Timing (Seconds)")]
    public float windUpTime = 1.5f;   // [VI] Thời gian gồng (Telegraph) / [EN] Wind-up time (Telegraph)
    public float recoveryTime = 1.5f; // [VI] Thời gian nghỉ sau khi đánh / [EN] Recovery time after striking

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // [VI] RESET COOLDOWN (Quan trọng khi chạy test trong Unity Editor)
    // [EN] RESET COOLDOWN (Important when playtesting in Unity Editor)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    private void OnEnable()
    {
        // [VI] Đảm bảo chiêu thức luôn sẵn sàng mỗi khi bật lại game
        // [EN] Ensure the skill is always ready every time the game restarts
        lastCastTime = -999f;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // [VI] KIỂM TRA ĐIỀU KIỆN (AI SẼ GỌI HÀM NÀY ĐỂ QUYẾT ĐỊNH)
    // [EN] CONDITION CHECK (AI CALLS THIS TO DECIDE)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    public virtual bool CanCast(FortressBoss boss, float distanceToPlayer)
    {
        // 1. [VI] Kiểm tra thời gian hồi chiêu / [EN] Check cooldown
        if (Time.time < lastCastTime + cooldown) return false;

        // 2. [VI] Kiểm tra tầm đánh / [EN] Check engagement range
        if (distanceToPlayer < minRange || distanceToPlayer > maxRange) return false;

        return true;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // [VI] THỰC THI CHIÊU THỨC (TRẢ VỀ IEnumerator ĐỂ CHẠY COROUTINE)
    // [EN] EXECUTE SKILL (RETURNS IEnumerator TO RUN COROUTINE)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // [VI] Lớp con bắt buộc phải viết code cho hàm này
    // [EN] Child classes are forced to write code for this function
    public abstract IEnumerator ExecuteSkill(FortressBoss boss);

    // [VI] Đánh dấu thời điểm dùng chiêu để bắt đầu tính Cooldown
    // [EN] Mark the cast time to start calculating Cooldown
    public void RecordCastTime()
    {
        lastCastTime = Time.time;
    }
}

// [FILE_START]: FortressBoss.cs
// PATH: ./Assets\_Archive_OldAI\BossSystem\FortressBoss.cs
// ------------------------------------------

﻿using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.AI;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;

public enum VisionStatus
{
    Visible,
    Obscured,
    Blinded,
    OutOfFOV,
    OutOfRange
}

public class FortressBoss : MonoBehaviour, IDamageable
{
    #region 1. VARIABLES & REFERENCES
    [Header("--- CORE STATS ---")]
    public float maxHealth = 500f;
    public float health;
    private bool _isDead = false;

    [Header("--- REFERENCES ---")]
    public NavMeshAgent agent;
    public Transform player;

    [Header("--- STATE MACHINE ---")]
    public PatrolState patrolState;
    public AttackState attackState;
    public FleeState fleeState;
    private FortressState _currentState;
    public FortressState CurrentState { get { return _currentState; } }
    public FortressState lastState;

    [Header("--- ADVANCED SENSORS & MEMORY ---")]
    public float detectionRange = 30f;
    public float loseTargetRange = 45f;
    public float fieldOfView = 120f;
    public float hearingRange = 25f;
    public LayerMask coverMask;
    public LayerMask blindMask;
    [Tooltip("Layer của kẻ thù (Đánh dấu Player và các AI phe địch) / Enemy Layers (Check Player and enemy AI factions)")]
    public LayerMask targetMask;
    [Space]
    public Vector3 lastKnownPosition;
    public bool hasLastKnownPosition = false;

    [Header("--- PHYSICAL LOCOMOTION ---")]
    public float maxForwardSpeed = 5f;
    public float turnSpeed = 60f;
    public float acceleration = 2f;
    public float patrolRange = 40f;
    public float minStepDistance = 15f;
    private float _currentForwardSpeed = 0f;

    [Header("--- HEAD & NECK CONTROL ---")]
    public Transform headBone;
    public float headTurnSpeed = 50f;
    public float maxHeadYaw = 60f;
    public float maxHeadPitch = 20f;

    [Header("--- COMBAT & SKILLS ---")]
    public List<BossSkill> availableSkills;
    public Transform firePoint;
    public bool lockRotation = false;
    public bool isCastingSkill = false;
    private Coroutine _knockbackCoroutine;
    public float comfortAngle = 45f;

    [Header("--- ARMOR SYSTEM ---")]
    public int activeArmorPieces = 0;
    public float armoredDamageMultiplier = 0.2f;

    [Header("--- VISUALS & VFX ---")]
    public GameObject deathVfxPrefab;
    public GameObject[] impactVfx40Percent;
    public GameObject[] impactVfx20Percent;
    private List<GameObject> _activeImpactEffects = new List<GameObject>();
    [Space]
    public Light stateLight;
    public Color patrolColor = Color.yellow;
    public Color attackColor = Color.red;
    public Color fleeColor = Color.cyan;

    [Header("--- STORY MODE ---")]
    [Tooltip("Nếu tick, Boss sẽ không nổ tung khi chết mà chờ kịch bản / If ticked, Boss won't explode on death but wait for script")]
    public bool isStoryBoss = false;

    [Header("--- TACTICAL RANGES & PARAMETERS ---")]
    [Tooltip("Dưới mức này, Boss ép góc càn quét cận chiến / Below this, Boss forces melee crush")]
    public float meleePunishRange = 20f;

    [Tooltip("Khoảng cách tối đa để Đi xéo/Đứng bắn / Max distance to Prowl/Stand Ground")]
    public float tacticalMaxRange = 75f;

    [Tooltip("Độ rộng của vòng cung khi Đi xéo / Width of the arc when Prowling")]
    public float prowlOffsetDistance = 35f;

    [Tooltip("Khoảng cách sai số để xác nhận đã đến nơi / Tolerance distance to confirm arrival")]
    public float arriveDistance = 5f;

    [Tooltip("Khoảng cách tìm điểm chạy trốn (Flee) / Distance to find escape point (Flee)")]
    public float escapeDistance = 80f;

    [Tooltip("Tốc độ hồi máu mỗi giây khi bỏ chạy / Healing rate per second when fleeing")]
    public float healPerSecond = 15f;

    [Tooltip("Thời gian tối thiểu của 1 Phase / Min duration of a Phase")]
    public float minPhaseTime = 15f;

    [Tooltip("Thời gian tối đa của 1 Phase / Max duration of a Phase")]
    public float maxPhaseTime = 20f;
    #endregion

    #region 2. UNITY LIFECYCLE
    private void Awake()
    {
        agent = GetComponent<NavMeshAgent>();
        if (player == null) player = GameObject.FindGameObjectWithTag("Player").transform;

        health = maxHealth;
        patrolState = new PatrolState(this);
        attackState = new AttackState(this);
        fleeState = new FleeState(this);

        agent.updatePosition = false;
        agent.updateRotation = false;

        // ====================================================================
        // [VI] FIX LỖI COOLDOWN: KHỞI TẠO BẢN SAO ĐỘC LẬP CHO TỪNG KỸ NĂNG
        // [EN] FIX COOLDOWN BUG: INSTANTIATE INDEPENDENT CLONES FOR EACH SKILL
        // ====================================================================
        if (availableSkills != null)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < availableSkills.Count; i++)
            {
                if (availableSkills[i] != null)
                {
                    // Tạo ra một bản clone để con quái này tự quản lý thời gian hồi chiêu riêng
                    // Create a clone so this monster manages its own cooldown
                    availableSkills[i] = Instantiate(availableSkills[i]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void Start() => SwitchState(patrolState);

    private void Update()
    {
        // [VI] Xác chết thì không được suy nghĩ hay chạy nhảy nữa
        // [EN] Corpses shouldn't think or run around anymore
        if (_isDead) return;

        if (_currentState != null) _currentState.UpdateState();
        CustomLocomotion();
    }

    private void LateUpdate()
    {
        if (_isDead) return;
        UpdateHeadLookAt();
    }
    #endregion

    #region 3. STATE MACHINE CONTROLLERS
    public void SwitchState(FortressState newState)
    {
        lastState = _currentState;
        if (_currentState != null) _currentState.ExitState();
        _currentState = newState;
        _currentState.EnterState();

        // =======================================================
        // [VI] CƠ CHẾ BẦY ĐÀN: Nếu bắt đầu tấn công, gọi đồng bọn
        // [EN] SWARM MECHANIC: If starting to attack, call allies
        // =======================================================
        if (newState == attackState && lastState != attackState)
        {
            AlertSwarm();
        }
    }

    private void AlertSwarm()
    {
        // [VI] Dùng hearingRange (tầm nghe) làm bán kính báo động
        // [EN] Use hearingRange as the alert radius
        Collider[] friends = Physics.OverlapSphere(transform.position, hearingRange);
        foreach (Collider col in friends)
        {
            FortressBoss ally = col.GetComponent<FortressBoss>();

            // [VI] Tránh gọi chính mình và các đồng minh đã chết
            // [EN] Avoid calling itself and dead allies
            if (ally != null && ally != this && ally.health > 0)
            {
                // [VI] Chỉ gọi những đứa đang đi tuần tra (chưa đánh)
                // [EN] Only call those who are patrolling (not attacking yet)
                if (ally.CurrentState != ally.attackState && ally.CurrentState != ally.fleeState)
                {
                    ally.lastKnownPosition = this.player.position; // [VI] Báo vị trí Player / [EN] Report Player position
                    ally.hasLastKnownPosition = true;
                    ally.SwitchState(ally.attackState);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void CheckFleeState()
    {
        if (health < 100 && _currentState != fleeState) SwitchState(fleeState);
    }

    public void SetStateColor(Color newColor)
    {
        if (stateLight != null) stateLight.color = newColor;
    }
    #endregion

    #region 4. SENSORS & PATHFINDING
    public VisionStatus CheckVision()
    {
        float activeVisionRange = (_currentState == attackState || _currentState == fleeState) ? loseTargetRange : detectionRange;
        Collider[] potentialTargets = Physics.OverlapSphere(transform.position, activeVisionRange, targetMask);
        Transform closestValidTarget = null;
        float minDistance = Mathf.Infinity;

        foreach (Collider col in potentialTargets)
        {
            if (col.gameObject == this.gameObject) continue;
            FortressBoss aiTarget = col.GetComponentInParent<FortressBoss>();
            if (aiTarget != null && aiTarget.health <= 0) continue;

            float dist = Vector3.Distance(transform.position, col.transform.position);
            Vector3 bossEye = transform.position + Vector3.up * 2f;
            Vector3 targetEye = col.transform.position + Vector3.up * 2f;

            LayerMask combinedMask = coverMask | blindMask;
            bool hasLineOfSight = true;

            if (Physics.Linecast(bossEye, targetEye, out RaycastHit hit, combinedMask))
            {
                if (hit.transform != col.transform && !hit.transform.IsChildOf(col.transform)) hasLineOfSight = false;
            }

            if (!hasLineOfSight) continue;

            Vector3 dirToTarget = (col.transform.position - transform.position).normalized;
            if (_currentState != attackState && Vector3.Angle(transform.forward, dirToTarget) > fieldOfView / 2f) continue;

            if (dist < minDistance)
            {
                minDistance = dist;
                closestValidTarget = col.transform;
            }
        }

        if (closestValidTarget != null)
        {
            player = closestValidTarget;
            lastKnownPosition = player.position;
            hasLastKnownPosition = true;
            return VisionStatus.Visible;
        }

        if (player != null)
        {
            FortressBoss playerBoss = player.GetComponent<FortressBoss>();
            if (playerBoss != null && playerBoss.health <= 0)
            {
                player = null;
                hasLastKnownPosition = false;
                return VisionStatus.OutOfRange;
            }

            float currentDist = Vector3.Distance(transform.position, player.position);
            if (currentDist > activeVisionRange) return VisionStatus.OutOfRange;

            Vector3 bossEye = transform.position + Vector3.up * 2f;
            Vector3 playerEye = player.position + Vector3.up * 2f;

            if (Physics.Linecast(bossEye, playerEye, out RaycastHit hit, coverMask | blindMask))
            {
                if ((blindMask.value & (1 << hit.collider.gameObject.layer)) > 0) return VisionStatus.Blinded;
                return VisionStatus.Obscured;
            }

            Vector3 dirToPlayer = (player.position - transform.position).normalized;
            if (_currentState != attackState && Vector3.Angle(transform.forward, dirToPlayer) > fieldOfView / 2f) return VisionStatus.OutOfFOV;

            return VisionStatus.Visible;
        }

        return VisionStatus.OutOfRange;
    }

    // ==============================================================
    // [VI] CHỨC NĂNG MỚI: KIỂM TRA KHÔNG GIAN BẰNG BÁN KÍNH AI
    // [EN] NEW FEATURE: CHECK SPACE USING AI RADIUS
    // ==============================================================
    public bool IsSpaceClear(Vector3 targetPosition)
    {
        // [VI] Nâng tâm khối cầu lên để tránh quét chạm vào mặt đất
        // [EN] Elevate the sphere center to avoid hitting the ground
        Vector3 checkPos = targetPosition + Vector3.up * Mathf.Max(agent.radius, 1f);

        Collider[] hits = Physics.OverlapSphere(checkPos, agent.radius * 0.9f, coverMask | blindMask);
        foreach (Collider hit in hits)
        {
            if (hit.transform.root != this.transform.root) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    // ==============================================================
    // [VI] CHỨC NĂNG MỚI: LẤY ĐIỂM DỪNG CHÂN AN TOÀN TRÁNH CLIPPING
    // [EN] NEW FEATURE: GET SAFE STOPPING POINT TO AVOID CLIPPING
    // ==============================================================
    public Vector3 GetSafeOffsetPosition(Vector3 targetPos)
    {
        Vector3 dirAwayFromTarget = (transform.position - targetPos).normalized;
        dirAwayFromTarget.y = 0;

        // [VI] Khoảng cách an toàn = Bán kính AI + 1 khoảng đệm
        // [EN] Safe distance = AI radius + a buffer distance
        float safeDistance = agent.radius + 1.5f;
        Vector3 safePos = targetPos + dirAwayFromTarget * safeDistance;

        if (UnityEngine.AI.NavMesh.SamplePosition(safePos, out UnityEngine.AI.NavMeshHit hit, 5f, agent.areaMask))
        {
            return hit.position;
        }
        return targetPos;
    }

    public Vector3 CalculatePatrolPosition()
    {
        Vector3 searchCenter = transform.position;
        float searchRadius = patrolRange;

        if (lastState == attackState && hasLastKnownPosition)
        {
            searchCenter = lastKnownPosition;
            searchRadius = 15f;
        }

        UnityEngine.AI.NavMeshPath path = new UnityEngine.AI.NavMeshPath();

        // [VI] Tăng lên 30 lần quét để đảm bảo tìm được chỗ trống
        // [EN] Increased to 30 scans to ensure finding an empty spot
        for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++)
        {
            Vector3 randomDirection = searchCenter + Random.insideUnitSphere * searchRadius;

            if (UnityEngine.AI.NavMesh.SamplePosition(randomDirection, out UnityEngine.AI.NavMeshHit navHit, 10f, agent.areaMask))
            {
                if (Vector3.Distance(transform.position, navHit.position) < minStepDistance) continue;

                // [VI] KIỂM TRA KHÔNG GIAN BẰNG COLLIDER TRƯỚC KHI TÍNH ĐƯỜNG
                // [EN] CHECK SPACE WITH COLLIDER BEFORE CALCULATING PATH
                if (!IsSpaceClear(navHit.position)) continue;

                if (UnityEngine.AI.NavMesh.CalculatePath(transform.position, navHit.position, agent.areaMask, path))
                {
                    if (path.status != UnityEngine.AI.NavMeshPathStatus.PathComplete) continue;
                }
                else continue;

                return navHit.position;
            }
        }
        return transform.position;
    }
    #endregion

    #region 5. PHYSICAL LOCOMOTION & KINEMATICS
    public void CustomLocomotion()
    {
        // [VI] MẤU CHỐT 1: Bỏ 'isCastingSkill' khỏi if này.
        // [EN] CORE 1: Removed 'isCastingSkill' from this if.
        // Để Boss không bị trượt như bóng ma khi đang cast chiêu.
        if (agent.isStopped)
        {
            _currentForwardSpeed = Mathf.MoveTowards(_currentForwardSpeed, 0f, acceleration * Time.deltaTime);
            agent.Move(transform.forward * _currentForwardSpeed * Time.deltaTime);
            transform.position = agent.nextPosition;
            return;
        }

        Vector3 desiredDirection = agent.desiredVelocity;
        desiredDirection.y = 0;

        if (desiredDirection.sqrMagnitude > 0.1f)
        {
            desiredDirection.Normalize();
            float angleDifference = Vector3.SignedAngle(transform.forward, desiredDirection, Vector3.up);
            float turnAmount = Mathf.Clamp(angleDifference, -turnSpeed * Time.deltaTime, turnSpeed * Time.deltaTime);

            float speedFactor = Mathf.Clamp01(_currentForwardSpeed / maxForwardSpeed);
            if (speedFactor < 0.2f) speedFactor = 0.2f;

            transform.Rotate(0, turnAmount * speedFactor, 0);
        }

        float angleToTarget = Vector3.Angle(transform.forward, desiredDirection);
        float targetSpeed = angleToTarget > 45f ? maxForwardSpeed * 0.5f : maxForwardSpeed;

        _currentForwardSpeed = Mathf.MoveTowards(_currentForwardSpeed, targetSpeed, acceleration * Time.deltaTime);
        agent.Move(transform.forward * _currentForwardSpeed * Time.deltaTime);
        transform.position = agent.nextPosition;
    }

    public void UpdateHeadLookAt()
    {
        if (headBone == null || isCastingSkill) return;

        Quaternion targetLocalRotation = Quaternion.identity;

        if (player != null && CheckVision() == VisionStatus.Visible)
        {
            Vector3 targetDir = player.position - headBone.position;
            Vector3 localTargetDir = transform.InverseTransformDirection(targetDir);

            float yaw = Mathf.Atan2(localTargetDir.x, localTargetDir.z) * Mathf.Rad2Deg;
            float distance = localTargetDir.magnitude;
            float pitch = -Mathf.Asin(Mathf.Clamp(localTargetDir.y / distance, -1f, 1f)) * Mathf.Rad2Deg;

            yaw = Mathf.Clamp(yaw, -maxHeadYaw, maxHeadYaw);
            pitch = Mathf.Clamp(pitch, -maxHeadPitch, maxHeadPitch);

            targetLocalRotation = Quaternion.Euler(pitch, yaw, 0f);
        }

        headBone.localRotation = Quaternion.RotateTowards(
            headBone.localRotation,
            targetLocalRotation,
            headTurnSpeed * Time.deltaTime
        );
    }
    #endregion

    #region 6. COMBAT & SKILLS
    public void ExecuteSkillSequence(BossSkill skill)
    {
        StartCoroutine(SkillSequenceRoutine(skill));
    }

    private IEnumerator SkillSequenceRoutine(BossSkill skill)
    {
        isCastingSkill = true;
        yield return StartCoroutine(skill.ExecuteSkill(this));
        isCastingSkill = false;
    }

    public void LazyRotateTowards(Vector3 targetPos)
    {
        // [VI] MẤU CHỐT 2: Tôn trọng biến lockRotation
        // [EN] CORE 2: Respect the lockRotation variable
        if (lockRotation) return;

        Vector3 dirToTarget = (targetPos - transform.position).normalized;
        dirToTarget.y = 0;
        if (dirToTarget == Vector3.zero) return;

        if (Vector3.Angle(transform.forward, dirToTarget) > comfortAngle)
        {
            transform.rotation = Quaternion.RotateTowards(
                transform.rotation,
                Quaternion.LookRotation(dirToTarget),
                turnSpeed * Time.deltaTime
            );
        }
    }
    #endregion

    #region 7. HEALTH, DAMAGE & KNOCKBACK
    public void TakeDamage(ArrowData data, Vector3 hitPoint, Vector3 hitNormal = default)
    {
        if (data == null || _isDead) return;

        float currentMultiplier = activeArmorPieces > 0 ? Mathf.Clamp01(armoredDamageMultiplier + data.armorPenetration) : 1f;
        float finalDamage = data.baseDamage * currentMultiplier;

        health -= finalDamage;
        SpawnImpactVfx(hitPoint, hitNormal);
        TriggerPainReflex();

        if (health <= 0) Die();
        else CheckFleeState();
    }

    public void TakeDamage(float damage, Vector3 hitPoint, float knockbackForce)
    {
        if (_isDead) return;

        float finalDamage = activeArmorPieces > 0 ? damage * armoredDamageMultiplier : damage;
        health -= finalDamage;

        Vector3 pushDir = (transform.position - hitPoint).normalized;
        SpawnImpactVfx(hitPoint, pushDir);
        ApplyKnockback(pushDir, knockbackForce);
        TriggerPainReflex();

        if (health <= 0) Die();
        else CheckFleeState();
    }

    public void TriggerPainReflex()
    {
        if (_currentState == patrolState)
        {
            if (Vector3.Distance(transform.position, player.position) <= loseTargetRange)
            {
                lastKnownPosition = player.position;
                hasLastKnownPosition = true;
                SwitchState(attackState);
            }
        }
    }

    public void ApplyKnockback(Vector3 direction, float force)
    {
        if (agent == null || !agent.isOnNavMesh) return;
        if (_knockbackCoroutine != null) StopCoroutine(_knockbackCoroutine);
        _knockbackCoroutine = StartCoroutine(SmoothKnockbackRoutine(direction, force));
    }

    private IEnumerator SmoothKnockbackRoutine(Vector3 direction, float force)
    {
        float duration = 0.25f;
        float elapsed = 0f;
        Vector3 pushVelocity = direction.normalized * (force * 0.1f) / duration;

        while (elapsed < duration)
        {
            elapsed += Time.deltaTime;
            agent.Move(pushVelocity * (1f - (elapsed / duration)) * Time.deltaTime);
            yield return null;
        }
    }

    private void Die()
    {
        if (_isDead) return;
        _isDead = true;

        StopAllCoroutines();

        // 1. [VI] Ngắt kết nối AI / [EN] Disconnect AI
        if (agent != null && agent.isOnNavMesh)
        {
            agent.isStopped = true;
            agent.enabled = false;
        }

        // 2. [VI] Kích hoạt Ragdoll chữa cháy / [EN] Activate emergency Ragdoll
        Rigidbody rb = GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
        if (rb == null) rb = gameObject.AddComponent<Rigidbody>();

        rb.isKinematic = false;
        rb.useGravity = true;
        rb.mass = 500f;
        // 3. [VI] Đẩy ngã xác chết / [EN] Push the corpse over
        rb.AddForce(-transform.forward * 5f + Vector3.up * 2f, ForceMode.Impulse);
        rb.AddTorque(Random.insideUnitSphere * 15f, ForceMode.Impulse);
        gameObject.layer = 0;
        gameObject.tag = "Untagged";
        TargetIcon icon = GetComponentInChildren<TargetIcon>(true);

        if (icon != null)
        {
            Destroy(icon.gameObject);
        }
        // 4. [VI] Hiệu ứng cháy nổ / [EN] Explosion VFX
        if (deathVfxPrefab != null)
        {
            GameObject vfx = Instantiate(deathVfxPrefab, transform.position + Vector3.up * 2f, Quaternion.identity);
            Destroy(vfx, 2f);
            if (CameraShaker.Instance != null) CameraShaker.Instance.Shake(8f, 1f);
        }
        if (isStoryBoss)
        {
            // [VI] Gửi một tin nhắn "ẩn" cho bất kỳ Script nào nằm chung trên cục General
            // [EN] Send a "hidden" message to any Script sitting on the General object
            SendMessage("OnStoryBossDefeated", SendMessageOptions.DontRequireReceiver);
        }
        // 5. [VI] KHÔNG BIẾN MẤT NGAY! Để lại xác 15 giây rồi mới dọn dẹp cho nhẹ máy
        // 5. [EN] DO NOT DISAPPEAR IMMEDIATELY! Leave corpse for 15 seconds then clean up to save performance
    }
    #endregion

    #region 8. ARMOR & VFX
    public void RegisterArmor() => activeArmorPieces++;

    public void UnregisterArmor(Vector3 hitNormal)
    {
        activeArmorPieces--;
        ApplyKnockback(hitNormal, 15f);
        TriggerPainReflex();
    }

    private void SpawnImpactVfx(Vector3 hitPoint, Vector3 hitNormal)
    {
        if (Random.value > 0.2f || _activeImpactEffects.Count >= 15) return;

        float hpPercentage = health / maxHealth;
        GameObject[] selectedVfxList = null;

        if (hpPercentage <= 0.2f) selectedVfxList = impactVfx20Percent;
        else if (hpPercentage <= 0.4f) selectedVfxList = impactVfx40Percent;

        if (selectedVfxList != null && selectedVfxList.Length > 0)
        {
            GameObject vfxPrefab = selectedVfxList[Random.Range(0, selectedVfxList.Length)];
            if (vfxPrefab != null)
            {
                Quaternion rotation = hitNormal != Vector3.zero ? Quaternion.LookRotation(hitNormal) : Quaternion.identity;
                _activeImpactEffects.Add(Instantiate(vfxPrefab, hitPoint, rotation, transform));
            }
        }
    }

    public void ClearAllImpactVfx()
    {
        foreach (GameObject vfx in _activeImpactEffects)
        {
            if (vfx != null) Destroy(vfx);
        }
        _activeImpactEffects.Clear();
    }

    public void UpdateDamageVisuals()
    {
        if (health / maxHealth > 0.5f && _activeImpactEffects.Count > 0)
        {
            ClearAllImpactVfx();
        }
    }
    #endregion

    #region 9. DEBUG & GIZMOS
    private void OnDrawGizmos()
    {
        Gizmos.color = Color.yellow;
        Gizmos.DrawWireSphere(transform.position, detectionRange);
        Gizmos.color = Color.red;
        Gizmos.DrawWireSphere(transform.position, loseTargetRange);

        Vector3 bossEye = transform.position + Vector3.up * 2f;
        Vector3 leftRay = Quaternion.Euler(0, -fieldOfView / 2f, 0) * transform.forward;
        Vector3 rightRay = Quaternion.Euler(0, fieldOfView / 2f, 0) * transform.forward;

        Gizmos.color = Color.blue;
        Gizmos.DrawRay(bossEye, leftRay * detectionRange);
        Gizmos.DrawRay(bossEye, rightRay * detectionRange);

        Vector3 leftComfort = Quaternion.Euler(0, -comfortAngle, 0) * transform.forward;
        Vector3 rightComfort = Quaternion.Euler(0, comfortAngle, 0) * transform.forward;
        Gizmos.color = new Color(1f, 0.5f, 0f, 0.5f);
        Gizmos.DrawRay(bossEye, leftComfort * detectionRange * 0.8f);
        Gizmos.DrawRay(bossEye, rightComfort * detectionRange * 0.8f);

        if (player != null)
        {
            Vector3 playerEye = player.position + Vector3.up * 2f;
            float dist = Vector3.Distance(transform.position, player.position);
            Vector3 dirToPlayer = (player.position - transform.position).normalized;

            // Xác định tầm nhìn hiển thị trên Gizmo / Determine vision displayed on Gizmo
            float activeGizmoRange = (Application.isPlaying && (_currentState == attackState || _currentState == fleeState)) ? loseTargetRange : detectionRange;

            if (dist > activeGizmoRange || Vector3.Angle(transform.forward, dirToPlayer) > fieldOfView / 2f)
            {
                Gizmos.color = Color.gray;
            }
            else
            {
                LayerMask combinedMask = coverMask | blindMask;
                bool isBlocked = Physics.Linecast(bossEye, playerEye, combinedMask);
                Gizmos.color = isBlocked ? Color.red : Color.green;
            }
            Gizmos.DrawLine(bossEye, playerEye);
        }
    }
    #endregion
}

﻿using UnityEngine;

// [VI] Không kế thừa MonoBehaviour vì đây chỉ là logic thuần túy
// [EN] Does not inherit MonoBehaviour because this is pure logic
public abstract class FortressState
{
    protected FortressBoss boss; // [VI] Tham chiếu đến cơ thể Boss / [EN] Reference to the Boss body

    // [VI] Constructor truyền Boss vào
    // [EN] Constructor passing the Boss in
    public FortressState(FortressBoss bossBrain)
    {
        this.boss = bossBrain;
    }

    public abstract void EnterState();
    public abstract void UpdateState();
    public abstract void ExitState();
}

// [FILE_START]: IndependentTurret.cs
// PATH: ./Assets\_Archive_OldAI\BossSystem\IndependentTurret.cs
// ------------------------------------------

﻿using System.Collections;
using UnityEngine;

public class IndependentTurret : MonoBehaviour, IDamageable
{
    #region 1. REFERENCES & STATS
    [Header("--- CORE REFERENCES ---")]
    public FortressBoss boss;
    public BossSkill turretSkill;
    public Transform firePoint;

    [Header("--- HEALTH & DESTRUCTION ---")]
    public float maxHealth = 150f;
    [SerializeField] private float _currentHealth;
    private bool _isDestroyed = false;

    [Header("--- VISUAL EFFECTS ---")]
    public GameObject lowHealthSparkVFX;
    [ColorUsage(true, true)] public Color flashColor = Color.white;
    public float flashDuration = 0.25f;

    private bool _hasSparked = false;
    private Coroutine _flashCoroutine;
    private Renderer _turretRenderer;
    private Material _mat;
    private Color _originalEmission;
    #endregion

    #region 2. SENSOR & COMBAT
    [Header("--- SENSOR & COMBAT ---")]
    public float maxRange = 35f;
    [Tooltip("Góc quét hình quạt trước mặt (Độ) / Frontal fan vision angle (Degrees)")]
    public float fieldOfView = 90f;

    [Tooltip("Layer của mục tiêu (Player, AllyZenith...) / Target layers")]
    public LayerMask targetMask;

    public LayerMask obstacleMask;
    public LayerMask blindMask;

    public float cooldownTime = 4f;

    private float _fireTimer = 0f;
    private bool _isFiring = false;
    private Vector3 _currentTargetPos;
    private bool _hasValidTarget = false;

    private Transform _currentTarget;
    #endregion

    #region 3. UNITY LIFECYCLE
    private void Start()
    {
        _currentHealth = maxHealth;
        _fireTimer = Random.Range(1f, cooldownTime);

        if (boss != null)
        {
            boss.RegisterArmor();
            gameObject.layer = boss.gameObject.layer;
        }

        _turretRenderer = GetComponent<Renderer>();
        if (_turretRenderer == null) _turretRenderer = GetComponentInChildren<Renderer>();

        if (_turretRenderer != null)
        {
            _mat = _turretRenderer.material;
            if (_mat.HasProperty("_EmissionColor"))
            {
                _mat.EnableKeyword("_EMISSION");
                _originalEmission = _mat.GetColor("_EmissionColor");
            }
        }
    }

    private void Update()
    {
        if (_isFiring || boss == null || firePoint == null || _isDestroyed) return;

        UpdateTurretSensor();

        if (_fireTimer > 0f) _fireTimer -= Time.deltaTime;

        if (_fireTimer <= 0f && _hasValidTarget)
        {
            StartCoroutine(FireRoutine());
        }
    }
    #endregion
    #region 4. SENSORS & SKILL EXECUTION
    private void UpdateTurretSensor()
    {
        _hasValidTarget = false;
        _currentTarget = null;

        Collider[] potentialTargets = Physics.OverlapSphere(transform.position, maxRange, targetMask);
        float minDistance = Mathf.Infinity;

        foreach (Collider col in potentialTargets)
        {
            if (boss != null && col.gameObject == boss.gameObject) continue;
            if (col.gameObject == this.gameObject) continue;

            FortressBoss aiTarget = col.GetComponentInParent<FortressBoss>();
            if (aiTarget != null && aiTarget.health <= 0) continue;

            Vector3 targetCenter = col.transform.position + Vector3.up * 1.5f;
            float dist = Vector3.Distance(transform.position, targetCenter);

            // 2. [VI] KIỂM TRA GÓC NHÌN HÌNH QUẠT (FOV)
            // 2. [EN] CHECK FAN FIELD OF VIEW (FOV)
            Vector3 dirToTarget = (targetCenter - transform.position).normalized;
            dirToTarget.y = 0;
            Vector3 forwardFlat = transform.forward;
            forwardFlat.y = 0;

            float angleToTarget = Vector3.Angle(forwardFlat, dirToTarget);
            if (angleToTarget > fieldOfView / 2f) continue;

            // =========================================================
            // 3. [VI] KIỂM TRA VẬT CẢN VÀ KHÓI (RAYCAST)
            // 3. [EN] CHECK OBSTACLES AND SMOKE (RAYCAST)
            // =========================================================
            LayerMask combinedMask = obstacleMask | blindMask;
            bool hasLineOfSight = true;

            // Dùng tia Linecast bắn từ nòng súng đến ngực mục tiêu / Shoot Linecast from barrel to target's chest
            if (Physics.Linecast(firePoint.position, targetCenter, out RaycastHit hit, combinedMask))
            {
                // [VI] Lỡ tia đập trúng phần thừa của Collider mục tiêu thì vẫn tính là nhìn thấy
                // [EN] If the ray accidentally hits the target's own collider, it still counts as visible
                if (hit.transform != col.transform && !hit.transform.IsChildOf(col.transform))
                {
                    hasLineOfSight = false; // Bị che khuất bởi tường hoặc khói / Obscured by wall or smoke
                }
            }

            if (!hasLineOfSight) continue; // Chuyển sang quét mục tiêu tiếp theo / Move to next target
            // =========================================================

            // 4. [VI] Khóa mục tiêu gần nhất
            // 4. [EN] Lock onto the closest target
            if (dist < minDistance)
            {
                minDistance = dist;
                _currentTarget = col.transform;
                _currentTargetPos = targetCenter;
                _hasValidTarget = true;
            }
        }
    }

    // ... [HÀM FireRoutine() GIỮ NGUYÊN BÊN DƯỚI / KEEP FireRoutine() INTACT BELOW] ...
    private IEnumerator FireRoutine()
    {
        _isFiring = true;

        Transform originalFirePoint = boss != null ? boss.firePoint : null;
        Transform originalPlayer = boss != null ? boss.player : null;

        if (boss != null)
        {
            boss.firePoint = this.firePoint;
            if (_currentTarget != null)
            {
                boss.player = _currentTarget;
            }
        }

        if (turretSkill != null && boss != null)
        {
            yield return StartCoroutine(turretSkill.ExecuteSkill(boss));
        }

        if (boss != null)
        {
            boss.firePoint = originalFirePoint;
            boss.player = originalPlayer;
        }

        _fireTimer = cooldownTime;
        _isFiring = false;
    }
    #endregion

    #region 5. DAMAGE, VFX & DESTRUCTION
    public void TakeDamage(ArrowData data, Vector3 hitPoint, Vector3 hitNormal = default)
    {
        if (data != null) TakeDamage(data.baseDamage, hitPoint, hitNormal);
    }

    public void TakeDamage(float damage, Vector3 hitPoint, float knockbackForce)
    {
        TakeDamage(damage, hitPoint, Vector3.up);
    }

    public void TakeDamage(float damage, Vector3 hitPoint, Vector3 hitNormal)
    {
        if (_isDestroyed) return;

        _currentHealth -= damage;

        if (boss != null) boss.TriggerPainReflex();

        if (_flashCoroutine != null) StopCoroutine(_flashCoroutine);
        _flashCoroutine = StartCoroutine(FlashRoutine());

        if (_currentHealth <= maxHealth * 0.3f && !_hasSparked)
        {
            _hasSparked = true;
            if (lowHealthSparkVFX != null)
            {
                Instantiate(lowHealthSparkVFX, hitPoint, Quaternion.LookRotation(hitNormal), transform);
            }
        }

        if (_currentHealth <= 0) Die(hitNormal);
    }

    private void Die(Vector3 hitNormal)
    {
        _isDestroyed = true;
        Debug.Log("<color=red>[TURRET]</color> Ụ súng đã bị phá hủy và rụng xuống!");

        if (boss != null) boss.UnregisterArmor(hitNormal);

        transform.SetParent(null);

        if (GetComponent<Collider>() == null) gameObject.AddComponent<BoxCollider>();

        Rigidbody rb = GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
        if (rb == null) rb = gameObject.AddComponent<Rigidbody>();

        rb.isKinematic = false;
        rb.collisionDetectionMode = CollisionDetectionMode.Continuous;
        rb.mass = 50f;

        Vector3 forceDir = (hitNormal + Vector3.up * 0.2f).normalized;
        rb.AddForce(forceDir * 20f, ForceMode.Impulse);
        rb.AddTorque(Random.insideUnitSphere * 15f, ForceMode.Impulse);

        gameObject.layer = LayerMask.NameToLayer("Default");

        Destroy(this);
        Destroy(gameObject, 15f);
    }

    private IEnumerator FlashRoutine()
    {
        if (_mat == null || !_mat.HasProperty("_EmissionColor")) yield break;

        float elapsed = 0f;
        float halfDuration = flashDuration / 2f;

        while (elapsed < halfDuration)
        {
            elapsed += Time.deltaTime;
            _mat.SetColor("_EmissionColor", Color.Lerp(_originalEmission, flashColor, elapsed / halfDuration));
            yield return null;
        }

        elapsed = 0f;
        while (elapsed < halfDuration)
        {
            elapsed += Time.deltaTime;
            _mat.SetColor("_EmissionColor", Color.Lerp(flashColor, _originalEmission, elapsed / halfDuration));
            yield return null;
        }

        _mat.SetColor("_EmissionColor", _originalEmission);
    }
    #endregion

    #region 6. GIZMOS
    private void OnDrawGizmosSelected()
    {
        // Vẽ vòng tròn tầm bắn / Draw range sphere
        Gizmos.color = new Color(0f, 1f, 1f, 0.1f);
        Gizmos.DrawWireSphere(transform.position, maxRange);

        // =================================================================
        // VẼ 2 ĐƯỜNG CHỈ BÁO GÓC NHÌN (FOV) / DRAW FOV INDICATOR LINES
        // =================================================================
        Vector3 leftBoundary = Quaternion.Euler(0, -fieldOfView / 2f, 0) * transform.forward;
        Vector3 rightBoundary = Quaternion.Euler(0, fieldOfView / 2f, 0) * transform.forward;

        Gizmos.color = Color.cyan;
        Gizmos.DrawRay(transform.position, leftBoundary * maxRange);
        Gizmos.DrawRay(transform.position, rightBoundary * maxRange);

        // Vẽ tia đỏ khi khóa mục tiêu / Draw red line when target locked
        if (Application.isPlaying && _hasValidTarget && firePoint != null)
        {
            Gizmos.color = Color.red;
            Gizmos.DrawLine(firePoint.position, _currentTargetPos);
            Gizmos.DrawWireSphere(_currentTargetPos, 0.5f);
        }
    }
    #endregion
}

// [FILE_END]: IndependentTurret.cs

﻿using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.AI;

#region 1. PATROL STATE
public class PatrolState : FortressState
{
    private bool _isWaiting = false;
    private float _waitTimer = 0f;

    private float _stuckTimer = 0f;
    private Vector3 _lastPosition;

    public PatrolState(FortressBoss boss) : base(boss) { }

    public override void EnterState()
    {
        boss.SetStateColor(boss.patrolColor);
        boss.agent.isStopped = false;
        _isWaiting = false;

        _stuckTimer = 0f;
        _lastPosition = boss.transform.position;
        boss.agent.SetDestination(boss.CalculatePatrolPosition());
    }

    public override void UpdateState()
    {
        if (_isWaiting)
        {
            _waitTimer -= Time.deltaTime;
            if (_waitTimer <= 0f)
            {
                _isWaiting = false;
                boss.agent.isStopped = false;
                _stuckTimer = 0f;
                _lastPosition = boss.transform.position;
                boss.agent.SetDestination(boss.CalculatePatrolPosition());
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (!boss.agent.pathPending)
            {
                bool isPathBroken = boss.agent.pathStatus == UnityEngine.AI.NavMeshPathStatus.PathPartial || boss.agent.pathStatus == UnityEngine.AI.NavMeshPathStatus.PathInvalid;

                // =========================================================
                // [VI] ĐÃ SỬA: CHỈ ĐẾM KẸT KHI ĐANG CỐ DI CHUYỂN
                // [EN] FIXED: ONLY COUNT AS STUCK WHEN TRYING TO MOVE
                // =========================================================
                if (!boss.agent.isStopped)
                {
                    if (Vector3.Distance(boss.transform.position, _lastPosition) < 0.5f)
                    {
                        _stuckTimer += Time.deltaTime;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        _stuckTimer = 0f;
                        _lastPosition = boss.transform.position;
                    }
                }

                if (boss.agent.remainingDistance < boss.arriveDistance || _stuckTimer > 5f || isPathBroken)
                {
                    if (boss.hasLastKnownPosition && boss.lastState != boss.attackState) boss.hasLastKnownPosition = false;

                    _isWaiting = true;
                    boss.agent.isStopped = true;

                    if (_stuckTimer > 5f || isPathBroken)
                    {
                        Debug.Log("<color=yellow>[PATROL]</color> Kẹt! Đang tìm hướng mới.");
                        _waitTimer = 0.5f;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        _waitTimer = Random.Range(2f, 5f);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (boss.CheckVision() == VisionStatus.Visible) boss.SwitchState(boss.attackState);
    }

    public override void ExitState()
    {
        _isWaiting = false;
        if (boss.agent != null && boss.agent.isOnNavMesh)
        {
            boss.agent.isStopped = false;
            boss.agent.ResetPath();
        }
    }
}
#endregion

#region 2. ATTACK STATE
public class AttackState : FortressState
{
    private enum CombatPhase { Chase, Prowl, StandGround, Punish }
    private CombatPhase _currentPhase = CombatPhase.Chase;

    private float _phaseTimer = 0f;
    private Vector3 _prowlTarget;
    private int _prowlDirection = 1;

    private float _stuckTimer = 0f;
    private Vector3 _lastPosition;

    public AttackState(FortressBoss boss) : base(boss) { }

    public override void EnterState()
    {
        boss.SetStateColor(boss.attackColor);
        _phaseTimer = 0f;
        _stuckTimer = 0f;
        _lastPosition = boss.transform.position;
    }

    public override void UpdateState()
    {
        VisionStatus status = boss.CheckVision();

        if (status == VisionStatus.Blinded || status == VisionStatus.OutOfRange)
        {
            boss.StopAllCoroutines();
            boss.isCastingSkill = false;
            boss.SwitchState(boss.patrolState);
            return;
        }

        Vector3 currentTargetPos = boss.hasLastKnownPosition ? boss.lastKnownPosition : boss.player.position;
        float distToPlayer = Vector3.Distance(boss.transform.position, currentTargetPos);

        // =========================================================
        // [VI] ĐÃ SỬA: KHÔNG ĐẾM KẸT NẾU ĐANG ĐỨNG YÊN HOẶC XẢ CHIÊU
        // [EN] FIXED: DO NOT COUNT STUCK IF STANDING STILL OR CASTING
        // =========================================================
        if (!boss.agent.isStopped && !boss.isCastingSkill)
        {
            if (Vector3.Distance(boss.transform.position, _lastPosition) < 0.5f)
            {
                _stuckTimer += Time.deltaTime;
            }
            else
            {
                _stuckTimer = 0f;
                _lastPosition = boss.transform.position;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            _stuckTimer = 0f;
            _lastPosition = boss.transform.position;
        }

        if (_stuckTimer > 5f)
        {
            Debug.Log("<color=yellow>[TACTIC]</color> Thoát kẹt! Tái thiết lập vị trí.");
            _stuckTimer = 0f;
            _phaseTimer = 0f;
        }

        if (boss.isCastingSkill)
        {
            boss.LazyRotateTowards(currentTargetPos);
            ExecutePhaseLogic(currentTargetPos, status);
            return;
        }

        if (status == VisionStatus.Visible && TryCastSkill(distToPlayer)) return;

        _phaseTimer -= Time.deltaTime;
        if (_phaseTimer <= 0f)
        {
            PickNewPhase(currentTargetPos, distToPlayer, status);
        }

        ExecutePhaseLogic(currentTargetPos, status);
    }

    private void PickNewPhase(Vector3 targetPos, float dist, VisionStatus status)
    {
        _phaseTimer = Random.Range(boss.minPhaseTime, boss.maxPhaseTime);

        if (status != VisionStatus.Visible || dist > boss.tacticalMaxRange)
        {
            _currentPhase = CombatPhase.Chase;
            return;
        }

        // =========================================================
        // [VI] ĐÃ SỬA: GIẢM TỶ LỆ ÉP GÓC ĐỂ BOSS CHỊU ĐI XÉO NHIỀU HƠN
        // [EN] FIXED: REDUCED PUNISH RATE SO BOSS PROWLS MORE OFTEN
        // =========================================================
        if (dist < boss.meleePunishRange && Random.value > 0.6f)
        {
            _currentPhase = CombatPhase.Punish;
            return;
        }

        _currentPhase = Random.value > 0.15f ? CombatPhase.Prowl : CombatPhase.StandGround;

        if (_currentPhase == CombatPhase.Prowl)
        {
            _prowlDirection = Random.value > 0.5f ? 1 : -1;
            bool foundSafeSpot = false;

            for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
            {
                Vector3 dirFromPlayerToBoss = (boss.transform.position - targetPos).normalized;
                Vector3 offsetDir = Quaternion.Euler(0, 60f * _prowlDirection + (i * 15f), 0) * dirFromPlayerToBoss;
                Vector3 potentialTarget = targetPos + offsetDir * boss.prowlOffsetDistance;

                if (UnityEngine.AI.NavMesh.SamplePosition(potentialTarget, out UnityEngine.AI.NavMeshHit hit, 10f, boss.agent.areaMask))
                {
                    if (boss.IsSpaceClear(hit.position))
                    {
                        _prowlTarget = hit.position;
                        foundSafeSpot = true;
                        Debug.Log($"<color=cyan>[TACTIC]</color> ĐI XÉO (Prowl)!");
                        break;
                    }
                }
                _prowlDirection *= -1;
            }

            if (!foundSafeSpot)
            {
                _currentPhase = CombatPhase.StandGround;
                Debug.Log("<color=orange>[TACTIC]</color> Kẹt góc, ĐỨNG YÊN TỬ THỦ!");
            }
        }
    }

    private void ExecutePhaseLogic(Vector3 targetPos, VisionStatus status)
    {
        Vector3 safeDestination = boss.GetSafeOffsetPosition(targetPos);

        switch (_currentPhase)
        {
            case CombatPhase.Chase:
                boss.agent.isStopped = false;
                boss.agent.SetDestination(safeDestination);

                if (status != VisionStatus.Visible && Vector3.Distance(boss.transform.position, safeDestination) < boss.arriveDistance)
                {
                    boss.hasLastKnownPosition = false;
                    boss.SwitchState(boss.patrolState);
                }
                break;

            case CombatPhase.StandGround:
                boss.agent.isStopped = true;
                boss.LazyRotateTowards(targetPos);
                break;

            case CombatPhase.Prowl:
                boss.agent.isStopped = false;
                boss.agent.SetDestination(_prowlTarget);
                break;

            case CombatPhase.Punish:
                boss.agent.isStopped = false;
                boss.agent.SetDestination(safeDestination);
                break;
        }
    }

    private bool TryCastSkill(float distance)
    {
        if (boss.availableSkills == null) return false;

        foreach (BossSkill skill in boss.availableSkills)
        {
            if (skill.CanCast(boss, distance))
            {
                boss.ExecuteSkillSequence(skill);
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public override void ExitState()
    {
        if (boss.agent != null) boss.agent.isStopped = false;
    }
}
#endregion

#region 3. FLEE STATE
public class FleeState : FortressState
{
    public FleeState(FortressBoss boss) : base(boss) { }

    public override void EnterState()
    {
        boss.SetStateColor(boss.fleeColor);
        boss.agent.speed = 12f;
        boss.agent.isStopped = false;
        boss.agent.SetDestination(GetBestEscapePoint());
    }

    public override void UpdateState()
    {
        if (boss.health >= boss.maxHealth / 3)
        {
            boss.SwitchState(boss.attackState);
            return;
        }

        if (boss.health < boss.maxHealth)
        {
            // 5. [VI] ĐỌC PARAMETER: Lượng máu hồi
            // 5. [EN] READ PARAMETER: Heal amount
            boss.health += boss.healPerSecond * Time.deltaTime;
            boss.health = Mathf.Clamp(boss.health, 0, boss.maxHealth);
            boss.UpdateDamageVisuals();
        }

        if (!boss.agent.pathPending && boss.agent.remainingDistance < boss.arriveDistance)
        {
            boss.agent.SetDestination(GetBestEscapePoint());
        }

        if (Vector3.Distance(boss.transform.position, boss.player.position) > boss.loseTargetRange)
        {
            boss.SwitchState(boss.patrolState);
        }
    }

    public override void ExitState() => boss.agent.speed = 2.5f;

    private Vector3 GetBestEscapePoint()
    {
        Vector3 bestPoint = boss.transform.position;
        float maxDistFromPlayer = 0f;

        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
        {
            Vector3 randomDir = Random.onUnitSphere;
            randomDir.y = 0;

            // 6. [VI] ĐỌC PARAMETER: Khoảng cách chạy trốn
            // 6. [EN] READ PARAMETER: Escape distance
            Vector3 testPoint = boss.transform.position + randomDir.normalized * boss.escapeDistance;

            if (NavMesh.SamplePosition(testPoint, out NavMeshHit hit, 10f, NavMesh.AllAreas))
            {
                float distToPlayer = Vector3.Distance(hit.position, boss.player.position);
                if (distToPlayer > maxDistFromPlayer)
                {
                    maxDistFromPlayer = distToPlayer;
                    bestPoint = hit.position;
                }
            }
        }
        return bestPoint;
    }
}
#endregion

// [FILE_START]: ChargeAttackSkill.cs
// PATH: ./Assets\_Archive_OldAI\BossSystem\BossSkill\ChargeAttackSkill.cs
// ------------------------------------------

﻿using System.Collections;
using UnityEngine;

[CreateAssetMenu(fileName = "ChargeAttack", menuName = "TheForbiddenDay/Boss Skills/Charge Attack")]
public class ChargeAttackSkill : BossSkill
{
    [Header("Charge Specs")]
    public float chargeSpeed = 18f;        // [VI] Tốc độ lao / [EN] Charge speed
    public float chargeAcceleration = 50f; // [VI] Gia tốc / [EN] Acceleration
    public float chargeDuration = 5f;      // [VI] Thời gian tối đa / [EN] Max duration
    public float hitRadius = 3f;           // [VI] Bán kính húc / [EN] Hit radius
    public float damage = 40f;             // [VI] Sát thương / [EN] Damage
    public float knockbackForce = 45f;     // [VI] Lực hất / [EN] Knockback force
    public LayerMask targetMask;           // [VI] Layer Player / [EN] Player Layer
    public GameObject impactVfx;           // [VI] VFX khi húc trúng / [EN] Impact VFX

    public override IEnumerator ExecuteSkill(FortressBoss boss)
    {
        RecordCastTime();

        // 1. [VI] GỒNG CHIÊU / [EN] WIND-UP
        Debug.Log("<color=red>[SKILL - CHARGE]</color> Boss đang gầm và lấy đà húc!");
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(windUpTime);

        // 2. [VI] LAO TỚI (CHASE & IMPACT) / [EN] CHARGING (CHASE & IMPACT)
        float startTime = Time.time;
        float originalSpeed = boss.agent.speed;
        float originalAccel = boss.agent.acceleration;

        boss.agent.isStopped = false;

        boss.agent.speed = chargeSpeed;
        boss.agent.acceleration = chargeAcceleration;
        bool hasHit = false;

        while (Time.time < startTime + chargeDuration && !hasHit)
        {
            boss.agent.SetDestination(boss.player.position);

            // =======================================================================
            // [VI] PHẦN FIX LỖI: TỰ ĐỘNG LÁI VÀ ÉP BOSS LAO ĐI BỎ QUA CUSTOM LOCOMOTION
            // [EN] BUG FIX: MANUALLY STEER AND FORCE BOSS TO DASH, IGNORING LOCOMOTION
            // =======================================================================
            Vector3 desiredDir = boss.agent.desiredVelocity;
            desiredDir.y = 0;

            if (desiredDir.sqrMagnitude > 0.1f)
            {
                // [VI] Bẻ lái xoay người về hướng Player (Xoay gắt hơn bình thường)
                // [EN] Steer and rotate towards Player (Sharper rotation than normal)
                Quaternion targetRot = Quaternion.LookRotation(desiredDir.normalized);
                boss.transform.rotation = Quaternion.RotateTowards(
                    boss.transform.rotation,
                    targetRot,
                    boss.turnSpeed * 1.5f * Time.deltaTime
                );
            }

            // [VI] Cắm đầu lao về phía trước với tốc độ húc
            // [EN] Dash forward head-first at charge speed
            boss.agent.Move(boss.transform.forward * chargeSpeed * Time.deltaTime);
            boss.transform.position = boss.agent.nextPosition;
            // =======================================================================

            Vector3 hitCenter = boss.transform.position + boss.transform.forward * 2f;
            Collider[] hits = Physics.OverlapSphere(hitCenter, hitRadius, targetMask);

            if (hits.Length > 0)
            {
                foreach (var hit in hits)
                {
                    IDamageable target = hit.GetComponent<IDamageable>();
                    if (target != null)
                    {
                        target.TakeDamage(damage, boss.transform.position, knockbackForce);

                        if (impactVfx != null)
                        {
                            GameObject vfx = Instantiate(impactVfx, hit.transform.position, Quaternion.identity);
                            Destroy(vfx, 2f);
                        }

                        hasHit = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            yield return null;
        }

        // 3. [VI] THU CHIÊU (RECOVERY) / [EN] RECOVERY
        boss.agent.ResetPath();
        boss.agent.isStopped = true;
        boss.agent.speed = originalSpeed;
        boss.agent.acceleration = originalAccel;

        Debug.Log("<color=white>[SKILL - CHARGE]</color> Boss đang khựng lại sau cú húc...");
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(recoveryTime);
    }
}

// [FILE_START]: EnergyCore.cs
// PATH: ./Assets\_Archive_OldAI\BossSystem\BossSkill\EnergyCore.cs
// ------------------------------------------

﻿using System.Collections;
using UnityEngine;

public class EnergyCore : MonoBehaviour, IDamageable
{
    [Header("--- CORE STATS ---")]
    public float maxHealth = 100f;
    [SerializeField] private float _currentHealth;
    private bool _isDestroyed = false;

    [Header("--- VISUAL EFFECTS ---")]
    public Renderer[] targetRenderers;
    [ColorUsage(true, true)] public Color flashColor = Color.cyan;
    public float flashDuration = 0.25f;
    public GameObject explosionVfx;

    private Material[] _mats;
    private Color[] _originalEmissions;
    private Coroutine _flashCoroutine;

    [Header("--- EXPLOSION MECHANICS ---")]
    public float explosionRadius = 15f;
    // [VI] Tách sát thương giáp và boss / [EN] Separated armor and boss damage
    public float armorExplosionDamage = 500f;
    public float bossExplosionDamage = 200f;
    public float explosionKnockback = 30f;
    public LayerMask targetMask;

    [SerializeField] private FortressBoss _fortressBoss;
    private void Start()
    {
        _fortressBoss.RegisterArmor();
        _currentHealth = maxHealth;

        int count = targetRenderers != null ? targetRenderers.Length : 0;
        _mats = new Material[count];
        _originalEmissions = new Color[count];

        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            if (targetRenderers[i] != null)
            {
                _mats[i] = targetRenderers[i].material;
                if (_mats[i].HasProperty("_EmissionColor"))
                {
                    _mats[i].EnableKeyword("_EMISSION");
                    _originalEmissions[i] = _mats[i].GetColor("_EmissionColor");
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public void TakeDamage(ArrowData data, Vector3 hitPoint, Vector3 hitNormal = default)
    {
        if (data != null) ApplyDamage(data.baseDamage, hitPoint, hitNormal);
    }

    public void TakeDamage(float damage, Vector3 hitPoint, float knockbackForce)
    {
        ApplyDamage(damage, hitPoint, Vector3.up);
    }


    private void ApplyDamage(float amount, Vector3 hitPoint, Vector3 hitNormal)
    {
        if (_isDestroyed) return;

        _currentHealth -= amount;
        _fortressBoss.TriggerPainReflex();
        if (_flashCoroutine != null) StopCoroutine(_flashCoroutine);
        _flashCoroutine = StartCoroutine(FlashRoutine());

        if (_currentHealth <= 0)
        {
            Explode(hitPoint);
        }
    }

    // =====================================================================
    // BẢN CẬP NHẬT: SÁT THƯƠNG ĐỘC LẬP CHO GIÁP VÀ QUÁI
    // UPDATED VERSION: INDEPENDENT DAMAGE FOR ARMOR AND MONSTER
    // =====================================================================
    private void Explode(Vector3 hitPoint)
    {
        _isDestroyed = true;
        _fortressBoss.UnregisterArmor(hitPoint);
        Debug.Log("<color=cyan>[ENERGY CORE]</color> Lõi phát nổ! Quét sạch giáp và gây sát thương lên Boss!");

        if (explosionVfx != null)
        {
            GameObject vfx = Instantiate(explosionVfx, transform.position, Quaternion.identity);
            Destroy(vfx, 1f);
        }

        Collider[] hits = Physics.OverlapSphere(transform.position, explosionRadius, targetMask);

        foreach (Collider hit in hits)
        {
            // 1. [VI] Lấy giao diện chịu đòn (từ chính nó hoặc object cha)
            // 1. [EN] Get damageable interface (from itself or parent object)
            IDamageable target = hit.GetComponent<IDamageable>();
            if (target == null) target = hit.GetComponentInParent<IDamageable>();

            if (target != null)
            {
                // [VI] Bỏ qua chính Lõi này để tránh lỗi loop / [EN] Ignore this exact Core to avoid loop errors
                if (target as MonoBehaviour == this) continue;

                // 2. [VI] Kiểm tra loại mục tiêu để áp dụng sát thương tương ứng
                // 2. [EN] Check target type to apply corresponding damage
                if (target is FortressBoss)
                {
                    // [VI] Nổ trúng Boss / [EN] Hit the Boss
                    Debug.Log($"<color=orange>[ENERGY CORE]</color> Đã nổ trúng Boss: {(target as MonoBehaviour).gameObject.name}");
                    target.TakeDamage(bossExplosionDamage, hit.transform.position, explosionKnockback);
                }
                else
                {
                    // [VI] Nổ trúng các Lõi Giáp khác / [EN] Hit other Armor Cores
                    Debug.Log($"<color=orange>[ENERGY CORE]</color> Đã phá hủy giáp: {(target as MonoBehaviour).gameObject.name}");
                    target.TakeDamage(armorExplosionDamage, hit.transform.position, explosionKnockback);
                }
            }
        }

        gameObject.SetActive(false);
    }

    private IEnumerator FlashRoutine()
    {
        if (_mats == null || _mats.Length == 0) yield break;

        float elapsed = 0f;
        float halfDuration = flashDuration / 2f;

        while (elapsed < halfDuration)
        {
            elapsed += Time.deltaTime;
            for (int i = 0; i < _mats.Length; i++)
            {
                if (_mats[i] != null) _mats[i].SetColor("_EmissionColor", Color.Lerp(_originalEmissions[i], flashColor, elapsed / halfDuration));
            }
            yield return null;
        }

        elapsed = 0f;
        while (elapsed < halfDuration)
        {
            elapsed += Time.deltaTime;
            for (int i = 0; i < _mats.Length; i++)
            {
                if (_mats[i] != null) _mats[i].SetColor("_EmissionColor", Color.Lerp(flashColor, _originalEmissions[i], elapsed / halfDuration));
            }
            yield return null;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < _mats.Length; i++)
        {
            if (_mats[i] != null) _mats[i].SetColor("_EmissionColor", _originalEmissions[i]);
        }
    }

    #region GIZMOS
    private void OnDrawGizmosSelected()
    {
        Gizmos.color = new Color(1f, 0.5f, 0f, 0.3f);
        Gizmos.DrawWireSphere(transform.position, explosionRadius);
    }
    #endregion
}

// [FILE_END]: EnergyCore.cs
// ==========================================


// [FILE_START]: FanBarrageSkill.cs
// PATH: ./Assets\_Archive_OldAI\BossSystem\BossSkill\FanBarrageSkill.cs
// ------------------------------------------

﻿using System.Collections;
using UnityEngine;

[CreateAssetMenu(fileName = "FanBarrage", menuName = "TheForbiddenDay/Boss Skills/Fan Barrage")]
public class FanBarrageSkill : BossSkill
{
    [Header("Barrage Settings")]
    public ArrowData projectileData;  // [VI] Kéo data mũi tên NỔ vào đây / [EN] Drag EXPLOSIVE arrow data here
    public int projectileCount = 5;   // [VI] Số lượng đạn / [EN] Number of projectiles
    public float spreadAngle = 60f;   // [VI] Độ rộng của hình quạt (Độ) / [EN] Width of the fan (Degrees)
    public float launchForce = 40f;   // [VI] Lực bắn / [EN] Launch force
    public float projectileLifetime = 20f;
    public override IEnumerator ExecuteSkill(FortressBoss boss)
    {
        RecordCastTime();
        boss.lockRotation = true;

        // 1. [VI] GỒNG CHIÊU / [EN] WIND-UP
        Debug.Log("<color=red>[SKILL - BARRAGE]</color> Boss đang sạc đạn nổ!...");
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(windUpTime);

        // 2. [VI] TUNG CHIÊU / [EN] STRIKE
        PerformStrike(boss);
        boss.lockRotation = false;

        // 3. [VI] THU CHIÊU / [EN] RECOVERY
        Debug.Log("<color=white>[SKILL - BARRAGE]</color> Boss đang nạp lại năng lượng...");
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(recoveryTime);
    }

    public void PerformStrike(FortressBoss boss)
    {
        if (boss.firePoint == null || projectileData == null || projectileData.arrowPrefab == null) return;

        // [VI] Hướng cơ bản nhắm thẳng vào ngực Player (Cộng thêm 1 chút trục Y để không bắn vào chân)
        // [EN] Base direction aiming right at Player's chest (Add a bit to Y axis to avoid shooting toes)
        Vector3 targetPos = boss.player.position + Vector3.up * 1.5f;
        Vector3 baseDirection = (targetPos - boss.firePoint.position).normalized;

        // [VI] Tính toán góc xoay cho từng viên đạn
        // [EN] Calculate rotation angle for each projectile
        float startAngle = -spreadAngle / 2f;
        float angleStep = spreadAngle / Mathf.Max(1, projectileCount - 1); // Tránh lỗi chia cho 0 / Avoid divide by 0

        for (int i = 0; i < projectileCount; i++)
        {
            float currentAngle = startAngle + (angleStep * i);

            // [VI] Xoay hướng bắn gốc quanh trục Y (Lên/Xuống giữ nguyên, chỉ xòe ra hai bên)
            // [EN] Rotate base direction around Y axis (Up/Down stays same, spreads sideways)
            Vector3 fireDir = Quaternion.AngleAxis(currentAngle, Vector3.up) * baseDirection;

            // [VI] Khởi tạo đạn
            // [EN] Instantiate projectile
            GameObject projectile = Instantiate(projectileData.arrowPrefab, boss.firePoint.position, Quaternion.LookRotation(fireDir));
            Destroy(projectile, projectileLifetime);
            // [VI] Nạp Data (Tái sử dụng Arrow.cs)
            // [EN] Load Data (Reusing Arrow.cs)
            Arrow arrowScript = projectile.GetComponent<Arrow>();
            if (arrowScript != null)
            {
                arrowScript.Initialize(projectileData);
                arrowScript.ReadyForLaunch();
            }

            // [VI] Bắn đạn đi
            // [EN] Launch projectile
            Rigidbody rb = projectile.GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
            if (rb != null)
            {
                rb.linearVelocity = fireDir * launchForce;
            }
        }
    }
}

// [FILE_START]: PredictiveShootSkill.cs
// PATH: ./Assets\_Archive_OldAI\BossSystem\BossSkill\PredictiveShootSkill.cs
// ------------------------------------------

﻿using System.Collections;
using UnityEngine;

[CreateAssetMenu(fileName = "PredictiveShoot", menuName = "TheForbiddenDay/Boss Skills/Predictive Shoot")]
public class PredictiveShootSkill : BossSkill
{
    [Header("Projectile Settings")]
    public ArrowData projectileData;  // [VI] Kéo mũi tên vào đây / [EN] Drag arrow here
    public float launchForce = 50f;   // [VI] Tốc độ bay của đạn / [EN] Projectile speed

    // [VI] Biến tạm để đo tốc độ Player / [EN] Temp variables to measure Player speed
    private Vector3 _previousPlayerPos;
    private Vector3 _estimatedPlayerVelocity;

    public override IEnumerator ExecuteSkill(FortressBoss boss)
    {
        RecordCastTime();

        // 1. [VI] GỒNG CHIÊU VÀ THEO DÕI VẬN TỐC / [EN] WIND-UP & TRACK VELOCITY
        Debug.Log("<color=red>[SKILL - PREDICT]</color> Boss đang ngắm bắn chặn đầu...");

        float timer = 0f;
        _previousPlayerPos = boss.player.position;

        // [VI] Liên tục cập nhật vận tốc Player trong lúc gồng
        // [EN] Continuously update Player velocity during wind-up
        boss.lockRotation = false;
        while (timer < windUpTime)
        {
            timer += Time.deltaTime;

            // Vận tốc = (Vị trí hiện tại - Vị trí cũ) / Thời gian
            // Velocity = (Current pos - Old pos) / Time
            _estimatedPlayerVelocity = (boss.player.position - _previousPlayerPos) / Time.deltaTime;
            _previousPlayerPos = boss.player.position;

            yield return null;
        }

        // 2. [VI] TUNG CHIÊU / [EN] STRIKE
        boss.lockRotation = true;
        PerformStrike(boss);

        // 3. [VI] THU CHIÊU / [EN] RECOVERY
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(recoveryTime);
    }

    private void PerformStrike(FortressBoss boss)
    {
        if (boss.firePoint == null || projectileData == null) return;

        // [VI] TÍNH TOÁN CHẶN ĐẦU / [EN] PREDICTIVE CALCULATION
        Vector3 targetPos = boss.player.position + Vector3.up * 1.5f; // [VI] Ngắm vào ngực / [EN] Aim at chest
        float distance = Vector3.Distance(boss.firePoint.position, targetPos);

        // [VI] Thời gian bay dự kiến / [EN] Estimated flight time
        float flightTime = distance / launchForce;

        // [VI] Vị trí tương lai = Vị trí hiện tại + (Vận tốc * Thời gian bay)
        // [EN] Future position = Current pos + (Velocity * Flight time)
        Vector3 predictedPos = targetPos + (_estimatedPlayerVelocity * flightTime);

        // [VI] Hướng bắn chính thức / [EN] Final firing direction
        Vector3 fireDir = (predictedPos - boss.firePoint.position).normalized;

        // [VI] SINH ĐẠN (Kèm theo logic dọn rác 5s) / [EN] SPAWN PROJECTILE (With 5s cleanup logic)
        GameObject projectile = Instantiate(projectileData.arrowPrefab, boss.firePoint.position, Quaternion.LookRotation(fireDir));
        Destroy(projectile, 5f);

        Arrow arrowScript = projectile.GetComponent<Arrow>();
        if (arrowScript != null)
        {
            arrowScript.Initialize(projectileData);
            arrowScript.ReadyForLaunch();
        }

        Rigidbody rb = projectile.GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
        if (rb != null)
        {
            rb.linearVelocity = fireDir * launchForce;
        }

        Debug.Log($"<color=orange>[SKILL - PREDICT]</color> Đã bắn! Vận tốc mục tiêu: {_estimatedPlayerVelocity.magnitude:F1} m/s");
    }
}

// [FILE_END]: PredictiveShootSkill.cs
// ==========================================


// [FILE_START]: RapidFireSkill.cs
// PATH: ./Assets\_Archive_OldAI\BossSystem\BossSkill\RapidFireSkill.cs
// ------------------------------------------

﻿using System.Collections;
using UnityEngine;

[CreateAssetMenu(fileName = "RapidFire", menuName = "TheForbiddenDay/Boss Skills/Rapid Fire")]
public class RapidFireSkill : BossSkill
{
    [Header("Rapid Fire Settings")]
    public ArrowData projectileData;  // [VI] Kéo data mũi tên/đạn vào đây / [EN] Drag arrow/bullet data here
    public int bulletCount = 15;      // [VI] Tổng số viên đạn sẽ bắn / [EN] Total number of bullets to fire
    public float fireRate = 0.1f;     // [VI] Độ trễ giữa 2 viên đạn (Tốc độ bắn) / [EN] Delay between 2 bullets (Fire rate)

    [Header("Ballistics")]
    public float launchForce = 50f;   // [VI] Lực bắn (Tốc độ đạn bay) / [EN] Launch force (Bullet speed)
    public float spreadAngle = 2f;    // [VI] Độ giật/lệch nòng súng / [EN] Gun recoil/spread angle
    public float projectileLifetime = 10f;

    public override IEnumerator ExecuteSkill(FortressBoss boss)
    {
        RecordCastTime();

        // [VI] Boss có thể đứng im gồng, nhưng NÒNG SÚNG (IndependentTurret) vẫn sẽ tự xoay
        // [EN] Boss might stand still to cast, but the GUN BARREL (IndependentTurret) will still rotate
        boss.lockRotation = true;

        // 1. [VI] GỒNG CHIÊU / [EN] WIND-UP
        Debug.Log($"<color=red>[SKILL - RAPID FIRE]</color> Sạc súng liên thanh! Bắn {bulletCount} viên!");
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(windUpTime);

        // 2. [VI] TUNG CHIÊU (XẢ ĐẠN LIÊN TỤC) / [EN] STRIKE (CONTINUOUS FIRE)
        for (int i = 0; i < bulletCount; i++)
        {
            // [VI] Đề phòng Boss chết hoặc mất Player giữa chừng lúc đang xả đạn
            // [EN] Prevent error if Boss dies or loses Player mid-barrage
            if (boss == null || boss.player == null || boss.firePoint == null) break;

            // [VI] LIÊN TỤC LẤY VỊ TRÍ MỚI CỦA PLAYER ĐỂ LIA SÚNG
            // [EN] CONTINUOUSLY GET PLAYER'S NEW POSITION TO TRACK
            Vector3 targetPos = boss.player.position + Vector3.up * 1.5f; // [VI] Nhắm ngực / [EN] Aim at chest
            Vector3 fireDir = (targetPos - boss.firePoint.position).normalized;

            // [VI] Thêm độ giật súng ngẫu nhiên (Tránh đạn đi thẳng 1 đường như Laze)
            // [EN] Add random gun spread (Prevent bullets going in a single straight laser line)
            if (spreadAngle > 0f)
            {
                fireDir = Quaternion.Euler(
                    Random.Range(-spreadAngle, spreadAngle),
                    Random.Range(-spreadAngle, spreadAngle),
                    0f) * fireDir;
            }

            // [VI] Khởi tạo đạn
            // [EN] Instantiate projectile
            GameObject projectile = Instantiate(projectileData.arrowPrefab, boss.firePoint.position, Quaternion.LookRotation(fireDir));
            Destroy(projectile, projectileLifetime);

            // [VI] Nạp Data vào viên đạn
            // [EN] Load Data into the bullet
            Arrow arrowScript = projectile.GetComponent<Arrow>();
            if (arrowScript != null)
            {
                arrowScript.Initialize(projectileData);
                arrowScript.ReadyForLaunch(); // [VI] Hàm có sẵn từ logic cũ của bạn / [EN] Existing func from your logic
            }

            // [VI] Bắn đạn đi
            // [EN] Launch projectile
            Rigidbody rb = projectile.GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
            if (rb != null)
            {
                rb.linearVelocity = fireDir * launchForce;
            }

            // [VI] Chờ một khoảng (FireRate) rồi mới bắn viên tiếp theo
            // [EN] Wait a fraction (FireRate) before shooting the next bullet
            yield return new WaitForSeconds(fireRate);
        }

        // 3. [VI] THU CHIÊU / [EN] RECOVERY
        boss.lockRotation = false;
        Debug.Log("<color=white>[SKILL - RAPID FIRE]</color> Xả đạn xong, đang làm mát nòng súng...");
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(recoveryTime);
    }
}

// [FILE_START]: TremorStompSkill.cs
// PATH: ./Assets\_Archive_OldAI\BossSystem\BossSkill\TremorStompSkill.cs
// ------------------------------------------

﻿using System.Collections;
using UnityEngine;

[CreateAssetMenu(fileName = "TremorStomp", menuName = "TheForbiddenDay/Boss Skills/Tremor Stomp")]
public class TremorStompSkill : BossSkill
{
    [Header("Stomp Specifics")]
    public float stompRadius = 15f;       // [VI] Bán kính vụ nổ / [EN] Explosion radius
    public float maxDamage = 50f;         // [VI] Sát thương cao nhất (Đứng ngay tâm) / [EN] Max damage (Standing at center)
    public float maxKnockbackForce = 30f; // [VI] Lực hất mạnh nhất / [EN] Max knockback force
    public GameObject stompVfxPrefab;     // [VI] Hiệu ứng đất đá vỡ / [EN] Ground shatter VFX
    public LayerMask targetMask;          // [VI] Layer của Player để quét / [EN] Player's Layer to scan

    public override IEnumerator ExecuteSkill(FortressBoss boss)
    {
        RecordCastTime();

        // [VI] MẤU CHỐT 4: Ép dừng di chuyển khi thực hiện đòn đánh vật lý
        // [EN] CORE 4: Force stop movement when executing a physical strike
        boss.agent.isStopped = true;
        boss.lockRotation = true;

        // 1. GIAI ĐOẠN GỒNG (TELEGRAPH)
        Debug.Log("<color=red>[SKILL - STOMP]</color> Boss đang đứng lên gồng! (Chờ Animation...)");
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(windUpTime);

        // 2. GIAI ĐOẠN TUNG ĐÒN (STRIKE)
        PerformStrike(boss);
        boss.lockRotation = false;

        // 3. GIAI ĐOẠN THU CHIÊU (RECOVERY)
        Debug.Log("<color=white>[SKILL - STOMP]</color> Boss đang thở dốc thu chiêu...");
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(recoveryTime);

        // [VI] Trả lại trạng thái được phép di chuyển
        // [EN] Return permission to move
        boss.agent.isStopped = false;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // [VI] HÀM PUBLIC ĐỂ DÙNG CHO ANIMATION EVENT SAU NÀY
    // [EN] PUBLIC FUNCTION TO USE FOR FUTURE ANIMATION EVENTS
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    public void PerformStrike(FortressBoss boss)
    {
        Debug.Log("<color=orange>[SKILL - STOMP]</color> BÙMM! Dậm chân!");

        Vector3 stompCenter = boss.transform.position;
        if (CameraShaker.Instance != null)
        {
            CameraShaker.Instance.Shake(5f, 0.5f);
        }
        if (stompVfxPrefab != null)
        {
            GameObject vfx = Instantiate(stompVfxPrefab, stompCenter, Quaternion.identity);
            Destroy(vfx, 1f);
        }

        Collider[] hits = Physics.OverlapSphere(stompCenter, stompRadius, targetMask);

        foreach (Collider hit in hits)
        {
            float distance = Vector3.Distance(stompCenter, hit.transform.position);
            float falloff = 1f - Mathf.Clamp01(distance / stompRadius);
            float finalDamage = maxDamage * falloff;
            float finalKnockback = maxKnockbackForce * falloff;

            IDamageable target = hit.GetComponent<IDamageable>();
            if (target != null)
            {
                // [VI] CHỈ CẦN DÒNG NÀY LÀ ĐỦ! Player sẽ tự nhận stompCenter làm điểm gốc để văng ra xa
                // [EN] THIS LINE IS ALL YOU NEED! Player takes stompCenter as the origin to fly away
                target.TakeDamage(finalDamage, stompCenter, finalKnockback);
            }
        }
    }
}
